panel.name: plus_privacy_stats

plus_ps_check_compat.name: plus_send_settings_stats
plus_ps_check_compat.label: Send the settings I changed with the viewer statistics
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: Every viewer sends statistics (frame rate, hardware, how long you were logged in) to Second Life while you are logged in. Checked: the ones sent at logout and quit also hold the settings you changed from the default, which helps Linden Lab see what people use. Unchecked: no settings are sent; the rest of the statistics are.

panel.plus_ps_text: (Only on/off, number and color settings. Never text, places, devices, login details, keys or the Charis settings.)
